_comment: Per-agent install targets for THIS pack. Each entry names the source folder inside this pack: 'agents-skills' = the one long-text folder every name+description harness shares, 'codex-skills' = the same text plus the Codex-only agents/openai.yaml, 'zcode-skills' = derived <=250-char descriptions for ZCode's metadata window. Several harnesses also scan the shared ~/.agents/skills root, so one install can reach many. Paths/fields verified against vendor docs (2026-09); unverified entries are skipped unless -VerifyPaths is passed.

dsh.notes: name must match ^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$; catalog description truncated at 500 chars; invalid frontmatter drops the skill silently

claude.notes: frontmatter allows ONLY name, description, allowed-tools, compatibility, license, metadata - any other key errors; description+when_to_use truncated at 1536 chars

codex.notes: SKILL.md needs name + description; agents/openai.yaml (interface + optional policy.allow_implicit_invocation) is the Codex-only extra file
codex.verify: codex -> the skills list; invoked as $skill-name

zcode.notes: description >1024 DROPS the skill; per-turn metadata injects only the first 250 chars of each description, and the metadata set shares one budget (past it only names are injected)
zcode.verify: ZCode -> Settings -> Skills -> Refresh; invoke with $skill-name

qoder.notes: name: lowercase/digits/hyphens, <=64 chars; description <=1024; project-level .qoder/skills overrides user level

cursor.notes: also discovers .cursor/skills and .agents/skills in nested project subdirectories, scoped to that subtree
cursor.verify: Cursor settings -> Skills; a skill must sit at <root>/<name>/SKILL.md

opencode.notes: recognizes name, description, license, compatibility, metadata only; description 1-1024 chars; name <=64, no leading/trailing hyphen, no '--'; also reads ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills

codebuddy.notes: name/description optional (directory name is the fallback); supports allowed-tools, disable-model-invocation, context, model but none are required

gemini.notes: discovery injects name + description into the system prompt; activation goes through the activate_skill tool with a user consent prompt

grok.notes: discovers ./.grok/skills (walked up), ~/.grok/skills, ~/.agents/skills, plus Claude Code marketplaces/plugins; unknown frontmatter keys ignored; supports when-to-use and disable-model-invocation

kimi.notes: user tier = $KIMI_CODE_HOME/skills (default ~/.kimi-code/skills) and ~/.agents/skills; project tier = .kimi-code/skills and .agents/skills; name/description optional; invoked as /skill:<name>

agents.notes: shared cross-tool root: scanned by DSH (rank 500), Cursor, opencode, Kimi, Grok and others - install once here to reach them all
agents.source: vendor docs of DSH / Cursor / opencode / Kimi / Grok
